title: Close Encounters Fishing Charters
specs: Fish species include tarpon, snook, red fish, black drum, cobia, triple tail, sea trout, jack crevalle, shark, king mackerel, barracuda, goliath grouper, largemouth bass, crappie, striped bass, catfish, panfish, gar fish, bowfin, american shad

Fishing locations include Ponce Inlet, Sebastian Inlet, Banana River Lagoon, Mosquito Lagoon, Lake Toho, St Johns River, Butler Chain of Lakes, Conway Chain of Lakes, Johns Lake, Lake Howell, Lake Harris, Lake Apopka

services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: CEFC provides everything you need to catch fish. Quality fishing poles, reels, bait and tackle are all included. Our boats are outfitted with premium yeti coolers that will be icy cold and ready for your snacks and drinks! The captain provides cold bottled water, feel free to bring extra as well as any other beverages you wish to have on board. blurb: Guests fish for a wide variety of species including tarpon, snook, red fish, black drum, cobia, and many others in diverse locations such as Ponce Inlet, Sebastian Inlet, Banana River Lagoon, and Mosquito Lagoon. The charters cater to all boating and fishing experience levels and provide quality gear and attentive captains. The goal is to create memorable fishing experiences for all guests.
